content: Dǝga Daadiija tlǝvuukwaha
Tǝhalakwaha kaa sagau kǝ kyalǝma Farisiyaha ard lii tsaga adzahadzah sagal ma Wurshalim da vak Yesu am nǝ iitǝra,
“Aujilbǝg kǝ mbǝrzahagh ar kǝlla dǝga daadijaha tlǝvuukwahi? Aɗaba ar maay bara dǝv lakwti ar da zaa kaf biya.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Kuramǝm, aujilbǝg kǝskuram am kǝlla adzahadzaha Daadamazhigǝl kwakyarvad dǝga daadijahawi?
Am nǝ Daadamazhigǝla, ‘Faarafǝg kǝ daadagh ard baabagha,’ dlaɓa ‘Baɗǝm dadda ɗaava daddaana bi babbaana, barari tsavva.’

Kuram am tsagtǝrtsag kǝ uudah taakiya, akwama mǝng nǝ uudani dǝ dǝgit kwada mǝlgaru kǝ daddaana bi babbaana, ngal tagaan taakiya, ‘Baɗǝm nǝ dǝgiti mammaa da tlǝkǝna nǝ uuram vakara, fanarafǝg kǝ Daadamazhigǝla.’ Mbakyarvad kwaha fǝghaara bi kǝ daddaan ard babbaan dǝvakai biya.
Mbakyarvad dǝgaha daadijaruwa, namdalnǝg nǝ uuram kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl kǝ dǝga lakǝra.
Kuram muuniyahaana! Mbats ba jiir nǝ tlayanngǝrǝn tagada nǝ Ishaiya tǝghǝr kǝskuram taakiya,

content.text: “‘Udahaana, ar fǝkwara bat vaa ghai kalti,
Ar ɓaggwa ba gyaan kǝ kwatnahǝra,
ar tsaga adzahadzaha uudah tǝghǝr kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla.’”

content: Dǝgiti fǝgaraa uud kǝ ndzǝga kwadlamb tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝla
Ɗahatǝrǝtɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ dzahava uudah da vakaana, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Cinngamcinnga am nǝghaakana.
Dǝgiti daadamma ghaiya kǝ uud bi wa fǝgara kwadlambǝr kǝ uud tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya. Bamma dǝgiti sagal ma ghaiyaana.”
Kaa sagau kǝ mbǝrzahaan da vak Yesu am nǝ iitǝra, “Agha sǝrgasǝrg taaki aandzaa badzgalbadzǝg nǝ ǝrviɗya Farisiyah sarta kwaraa cinnga nǝ iitǝr kǝ ǝlbǝgna?”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Baɗǝm nǝ riigi kwa riiya nǝ Daadari ma ghǝrazhigǝl biya, da taɗava.
Aaɗuwamtǝrɗuuga. Ar gulfah nǝ iitǝra, lii taɗa gulfaha. Akwama gulf wa taɗa gulfa, ba bǝrkuɗaatǝr ar mbǝɗa daay damma afǝka.”
Aiyam nǝ Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Tagkǝmndtagg kǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ garavna.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Mbats gwaastǝn nǝghamaaka biya?
Baɗǝm nǝ dǝgiti zǝguu nǝ uuda, ba zǝnngw da bak ghaiyaana, kaa damma huɗaana, tǝhala kwaha kaa sagal ma vǝghaana.
Dǝgiti aa sagal ma ghaiya uuda, aa sǝgal bamma ǝrviɗmahuɗaana. Iin wa fǝgara ndzǝgaana kwadlambǝr kǝ uud tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝla.
Aɗaba sagal bamma ǝrviɗmahuuɗ nǝ dzama dǝgit ghwaɗa, ndǝ tsa sifǝga, ɓa gwaragwara, ɓa gǝlla, shiida fiida, ard badza ɗaaga.
Kwanahaan wa fǝgaraa ndzǝgaana kwadlambǝr kǝ uud tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝla, za kaf kwaal bara dǝv bi wa fǝgaraa ndzǝgan kwadlambǝr kǝ uud tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya.”
Fadghǝra uusa yaa Kanˈana
Ɗughars ba nǝ Yesu kwahiin kǝ vakavaka, ngal dagal kǝ iin damma larda Taya ard Sidon,
Kaa huula saas kǝ uusa yaa Kanˈana, amaa, “Zhukwadalaazhuug, Yaazhigǝla, Zǝra Dauda. Mǝng nǝ dǝghwar kwa vǝlgar nǝ shatanah kǝ dlaɗ ba vaivaiya.”
Tagghar bi nǝ Yesu aanji ndau biya, kaa ba sagau kǝ mbǝrzahaa da ghalgaana, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Lagwarslagw kǝ uusna, aɗaba gata kǝmyamma dlaɓa mbakiyammbǝg dǝ huulǝga.”
Ngwatǝrangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Ɓǝlakwadi mbakyarvad tughwaha Israˈilǝn zaharazahǝgǝn nǝ uuda, mbakyarvad uudahi tlǝrǝn biya.”
Ngal sagau kǝ iin kǝlla kǝ ghunnj tǝvuukwana amaa, “Yaazhigǝla, mǝlwadmǝlga.”
Aiyamaa, “Kalkalaan bi kǝ kǝsvant nǝ kaffa zarh ɓǝlǝvtǝrda kǝ ghǝgyah biya.”
Amaa, “Aana, bandkwah, Yaazhigǝla, aanji ghǝgyaha ar cagaan kǝ pashpasha kaffi ɓalgal vaka zǝg kǝ dadda hǝnyahaatǝra.”
Kaa ngugarangugg kǝ Yesu amaa, “Uusǝna, fadghǝragh ndzǝɗandzǝɗana, tsakatsǝg nǝ uud kǝ puutagha.” Bat watsǝr kaa mbǝgambǝg kǝ dǝghwaana.
Mbahghanambahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ uudah baɗyaka
Ciyit ba vaakwahiin nǝ Yesu kaa ta ghaiya Yuwa haiya Galili. Ngal dagat kǝ iin dat kungula aghwa, cǝhurana.
Kaa sagau kǝ uudah baɗyak da vakaan dǝ ghurɗikaha, gulfaha, lii ǝmtsamtsan nǝ uuɓiya, makwayaha, ard uudahi tlǝrǝn baɗyaka, ar ɗiitǝra tǝvuukwana. Ngal mbahtǝrana.

Nǝghgha ba nǝ uudah kǝ makwayah ar taa ghaiya, lii ǝmtsamtsan nǝ uuɓiya, uuɓiyatǝr nalnǝg balapiya, ghurɗikah ar dagala, gulfah dlaɓ ar nǝghǝganǝghǝga. Kaa galla Daadamazhigǝla yaa Izraˈila kǝ iitǝr baɗǝmma.
Vǝlatǝrvǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ dǝga zǝg kǝ uudah alfu uufaɗa

Tǝhala kwaha, ngal ɗahtǝrǝtɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan amaa, “Ən ɓa zhuwadaala kwanǝn kǝ uudaha, hǝngah hǝkǝrɗ wan kwana ar ba ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya, ba kwal dǝgzǝga. Ən naay kǝ ɗutǝrǝsɗuug daas dǝ wai biya, aɗaba haik ɗiya haar kǝ iitǝr tǝghǝrdǝga.”
Am nǝ mbǝrzah taa kǝ iina, “Da tlǝvkǝna mǝr nǝ dǝgzǝgǝn da tlǝtǝraara kǝ uudahaan ma tǝghal vaakwani?”
Kaa ndavtǝruundavǝg kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Ɗummba bruudi ngwɛn wa vakaruwi?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Uuɗiifa ard mishish kilf hǝɗiikǝna.”
Kaa fǝtǝraafǝg kǝ iin kǝ dlamakǝlaaw cahwargan tǝ haaya.
Kǝsant kǝ iin kǝ ɗummba bruudi uuɗiifǝn ard kilfna, tagar kǝ iin kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla lahnana. Vǝltǝr kǝ iin kǝ mbǝrzahaana, kaa vǝltǝr nǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝ uudaha.
Baɗǝmaatǝr zaruuzǝga, tlatǝrtlǝga, kaa dzahgantdzahǝg nǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝ ghwadgahaan ar rɛghant kǝ alǝghwah uuɗiifa.
Uudahi zaruuzǝga, tamaha damma ghwalvah alfu uufaɗa, maay ba nǝ ǝnghwasah ard zarh biya.
Salamada ba nǝ iin kǝ uudaha, kaa damma pɛra yuwa, ngal dagal damma haaya Magadan.
